name: livemap
description: Authoring tool for interactive live-event maps

scripts.build: npm run build -w @livemap/core && npm run build -w @livemap/renderer && npm run build -w @livemap/api && npm run build -w @livemap/viewer && npm run build -w @livemap/editor
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @livemap/core && npm run typecheck -w @livemap/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @livemap/api && npm run typecheck -w @livemap/viewer && npm run typecheck -w @livemap/editor
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
